questions.stem: What is the first stage in the formation of a star?

options.text: A cloud of gas and dust (nebula) begins to collapse under gravity
A white dwarf begins to accumulate mass
A red giant sheds its outer layers

questions.explanation: Star formation begins when a cloud of gas and dust, known as a nebula, starts to collapse under its own gravitational attraction. As the material contracts, it heats up, eventually forming a protostar.
